Invoice basics

Everything a new business owner should know before creating an invoice

What should a freelancer invoice include?

Include your name or business name, client details, invoice number, issue date, due date, service details, rate, tax, total and payment terms.

Hourly vs project invoice

Hourly invoices should show hours and rate. Project invoices can use milestones, deliverables or fixed package line items.

Should freelancers add GST?

Add GST only when it applies to your business. If unsure, confirm registration and tax rules with your accountant.

Why use PDF?

PDF invoices look consistent on client devices and are easier to store as business records.

Practical tips

Invoice details that help clients pay faster

Mention project name, milestone or month in the item description.
Use payment terms like due within 7 days or due on receipt.
Add GST details only when applicable to your freelance business.
For retainers, mention the covered service period clearly.
For hourly work, include hours and rate so the total is transparent.
